content: TABS (Landfall, 2019/1.0 2021) is a physics ragdoll battle simulator. Core loop: place two armies on a battlefield, then watch them fight under wobbly physics with no player input. Features: 140+ wobbler unit types across themed factions, campaign (25+ levels), sandbox mode, unit/faction creator, map creator, battle creator, unit possession, online multiplayer. Watchability comes from chaotic ragdoll physics, comedy, emergent unpredictable outcomes, and faction variety. Complexity for us: unit roster and placement are table stakes; unit creator/campaign/multiplayer are anti-features for the combat milestone.
